gap_dispositions.decision: Carry the named community, speaker or performer, collective authority, purpose, audience, permission and return status separately from citation and access.
gap_dispositions.reason: Publication, transcription, consultation and public description do not transfer political, ceremonial, land or knowledge authority.

gap_dispositions.decision: Retain source terms, language, partial gloss, translator and explicit non-equivalence; never align by shared English gloss alone.
gap_dispositions.reason: Balance, harmony, relation, duty, good life and reciprocity distribute different structures in different languages.

gap_dispositions.decision: Keep land or ocean relation, genealogy, community, jurisdiction and political history attached; do not normalize them into location or environment fields.
gap_dispositions.reason: Place often constitutes person, authority and obligation rather than merely providing context.

gap_dispositions.decision: Carry performer, audience, occasion, genre, version, recording or archive and living transmission as first-class custody.
gap_dispositions.reason: A transcript or heritage listing cannot own the authority, variation or embodied warrant of performance.

gap_dispositions.decision: Represent relational entry, revisable permission, community benefit, return and collective validation in addition to conventional citation.
gap_dispositions.reason: Research process determines whether a record is accountable, not only whether a source is bibliographically recoverable.

gap_dispositions.decision: Attach the concrete institution, history, mechanism and dissent whenever a concept is nationalized, codified, archived or mobilized by a state.
gap_dispositions.reason: Official recognition can preserve knowledge while changing its owner, audience and political force.

gap_dispositions.decision: Retain locally named relation, roles, asymmetries, time horizon, repair, refusal and power instead of a universal relation or reciprocity measure.
gap_dispositions.reason: Reciprocity may constitute persons and obligations and cannot be assumed symmetric, immediate or transactional.

gap_dispositions.decision: Expose procedure, role, authority, disagreement, coercion and restoration rather than scoring consensus or harmony as outcomes.
gap_dispositions.reason: Apparent agreement may result from living procedure, rank, conflict avoidance, repair or suppressed dissent.

gap_dispositions.decision: Keep all eighteen community, movement, language and national scopes addressable and non-interchangeable through GPC-09.
gap_dispositions.reason: A shared lane is an audit device, not evidence of one worldview or owner.

product_value.reader: A reader comparing relation, good life, land, authority, reciprocity, consensus, identity or knowledge across traditions without assuming shared words mean shared concepts.
product_value.job: See the source-local structure, who may speak or share it, how language and genre carry it, and exactly what a crosswalk preserves or loses.
product_value.current_friction: Current entries can flatten collective authority into provenance, land into context, performance into text, reciprocity into transaction and public access into permission.
product_value.smallest_future_product_change: After GPC-09, expose only recurring custody and mapping facets—authority to share, language/gloss status, land/genealogy relation, performance event, archive, return/validation and state appropriation—without creating tradition entries.
product_value.evidence_now: Bibliographic source review, source-local structural factoring, candidate mapping and repository validation only.
product_value.evidence_later: Community-qualified review, primary-language review and external reader comprehension, findability and return-use evidence.
product_value.cost_and_displacement: Eighteen immutable records increase alignment and maintenance work; premature canon entries would add navigation burden and appropriation risk.
product_value.continue_merge_stop: Retain every source-local record, merge none, stop lane content work and proceed to one-pass GPC-09 reconciliation.

stop: Freeze GPC-08 custody; perform no local admission; execute GPC-09 across PFC-01 and GPC-02 through GPC-08.
